pdf_explanation: The pattern on the left is rotated by 90° clockwise and then streched horizontally to obtain the pattern on the right.
why: From figure 1 to figure 2, the drop shape is turned 90° clockwise (its point now faces right) and then stretched sideways, so it becomes long and flat. Do the same to figure 3: after turning it 90° clockwise, the corner squares move to the top-right and bottom-left, and after stretching it becomes a wide rectangle - this is option 3. Option 1 is also stretched sideways, but it was not turned, so its outside squares are still at the top-left and bottom-right.
trick: When a shape is both turned and stretched, first check where a corner piece ends up after the turn, then check the overall shape is wide or tall.
note: PDF answer C matches the figures: rotate 90° clockwise then stretch horizontally.
